description: Java class 'SecuredUpload' providing security checks for file uploads, including validation of file types, extensions, content, and embedded files to prevent security vulnerabilities.

classes.name: SecuredUpload
classes.description: Main class providing security validation methods for uploaded files, including type, content, and embedded file checks.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Checks if the text content contains webshell tokens and string concatenation, ensuring security.

methods.name: isValidFileName
methods.description: Validates filename for length, extension, and character restrictions to prevent security issues.

methods.name: isValidFile
methods.description: Main method to validate a file based on its type, content, and security rules.

methods.name: isValidImageFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a supported and safe image format.

methods.name: imageMadeSafe
methods.description: Sanitizes an image by resizing and re-saving to prevent embedded threats.

methods.name: isValidImageIncludingSvgFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a valid image or SVG.

methods.name: isValidSvgFile
methods.description: Validates SVG files by parsing and content validation.

methods.name: isPdfFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a valid PDF by attempting to load it.

methods.name: isValidPdfFile
methods.description: Validates PDF files for embedded scripts and secure embedded files.

methods.name: isValidCsvFile
methods.description: Validates CSV files for correct format and content.

methods.name: isExecutable
methods.description: Detects executable files based on MIME type to prevent malicious uploads.

methods.name: isValidCompressedFile
methods.description: Validates ZIP and similar compressed files, including nested directory checks.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromFileName
methods.description: Detects MIME type of a file using Apache Tika.

methods.name: isValidDirectoryInCompressedFile
methods.description: Recursively validates files within a compressed archive.

methods.name: recursiveParserWrapper
methods.description: Extracts metadata and content from archives and embedded documents using Tika.

methods.name: isValidAudioFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a supported audio format.

methods.name: isValidVideoFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a supported video format.

methods.name: isValidTextFile
methods.description: Validates text files for encoding and security threats like SSTI.

methods.name: deleteBadFile
methods.description: Deletes files deemed insecure or invalid.

methods.name: getDeniedFileExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves list of disallowed file extensions from properties.

methods.name: getDeniedWebShellTokens
methods.description: Retrieves list of webshell tokens from properties.

methods.name: checkMaxLinesLength
methods.description: Checks if a file exceeds maximum allowed line length.
